Subtler: monochrome kerbs and topographic relief

Colourful road kept. Kerbs now a faint dashed line in the text colour. Relief = contour lines every 2 m, every fifth line slightly heavier, interpolated from the lap's own altitude (373 to 470 m): an impression of the terrain, not survey data. North up.
